faf1282f8ead3350.column_purpose: Person's ID (e.g. 'roushed01', 'faberre01'), referencing the player table; many rows per person, one per year of candidacy.

2256e0cc70d0f49c.column_purpose: Year of the Hall of Fame ballot/consideration (1936-2016).

ac76f7aa5a016b9e.column_purpose: Voting body or election mechanism: BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association), Veterans Committee, Run Off, Nominating Vote, Old Timers, Special Election, Negro League, Final Ballot.

308a501f2c8c6d10.column_purpose: Total ballots cast in that year's vote (empty for committee selections without ballots).

b4b2235b8525fd1d.column_purpose: Votes required for induction in that election (typically ~75% of ballots; empty when no ballot count).

33c556f870844afc.column_purpose: Votes the candidate received in that election; empty for non-ballot selections.

5373dfdc04e165bc.column_purpose: Y/N flag for whether the candidate was inducted into the Hall of Fame that year.

463f7a9b188f2720.column_purpose: Role for which the person was considered: Player, Manager, Umpire, or Pioneer/Executive.

9b49e055dc6a4722.column_purpose: Note qualifying the vote-requirement basis for that election, e.g. '1st' (first ballot) or 'Top 20'; empty for most rows. Plausible alternative: it may instead flag a special eligibility rule or election type rather than the vote threshold itself, so the exact semantics remain uncertain.

0ad2572a9ec5281f.column_purpose: Unique player identifier (Lahman playerID format: first 5-6 letters of last name + first 2 of first name + serial, e.g. aaronha01 = Hank Aaron). Primary key, referenced by all other tables.

54123f1167d65a84.column_purpose: Country of birth (USA, D.R., Venezuela, P.R., CAN, etc.).

63f89cd569be578a.column_purpose: State or province of birth for US/Canada players (CA, PA, NY...); for other countries holds a region/county name (e.g. Holguin in Cuba, Worcestershire in England).

f507c05eb1bccb18.column_purpose: Year of death; empty for living players (~half the rows).

be569dd3175ec1c0.column_purpose: Month of death (1-12); empty for living players.

32931706047c6bf3.column_purpose: Day of month of death (1-31); empty for living players.

98cc536673b424a5.column_purpose: Country of death; empty for living players.

df75b257f785005d.column_purpose: State/province of death; empty for living players.

f902e20042b96a46.column_purpose: City of death; empty for living players.

16aeec2520febf7d.column_purpose: Player's commonly used first name or nickname (Lahman nameFirst; includes nicknames like 'Sugar', 'Happy', 'Gabby').

4d93bc266f75da16.column_purpose: Player's full given name, often first + middle (Lahman nameGiven).

2ea9b196405a160a.column_purpose: Player identifier (e.g. bondsba01 = Barry Bonds); references player.col_001. Top values are prolific award winners, consistent with a per-award row per player.

9385f06a877ad499.column_purpose: Name of the award received (e.g. Most Valuable Player, Gold Glove, TSN All-Star, Silver Slugger, NLCS MVP).

aafd1b12f43b2e0d.column_purpose: Season/year the award was given; range 1877-2015.

1522e4df45ad2a3b.column_purpose: League the award was given in: AL = American League, NL = National League, ML = Major League (both/all of MLB, e.g. All-Star or overall awards), AA = American Association (19th century league).

ff71935419c34c07.column_purpose: Flag indicating the award was shared/tied: 'Y' when multiple players received the same award in the same league and season, empty otherwise. Only 45 rows, consistent with rare tied awards. Alternative reading: could mark some other special condition of the award, but the tie interpretation fits the rare 'Y' values best.

aa3d00fcbb0f0b3f.column_purpose: Supplementary note about the award, most often the player's position for All-Star selections (OF, SS, 3B, 1B, RF, DH, LHP) or which game/instance (e.g. '1st Game', 'P4' likely 4th pitcher or similar). Empty when not applicable. Exact code meanings beyond positions are unresolved.

c906cbf6698f13bb.column_purpose: Name of the award being voted on: MVP, Rookie of the Year, or Cy Young.

d4cce81f11240147.column_purpose: League of the award: AL (American League), NL (National League), ML (both leagues combined, likely pre-league-split or overall awards).

cdc4ccdbded760af.column_purpose: Player identifier (Lahman-style player ID) referencing player.col_001; the player who received votes.

f9753c9cfb74de2e.column_purpose: Voting points the player received in that award balloting (weighted vote points; 1.0 for the winner in modern MVP voting).

23e084b1cd00841b.column_purpose: Maximum possible voting points that season (e.g., 336 for modern MVP with two voters per league city, 140/420 for other eras or awards); the denominator for vote share.

1ca3b589b1e34f1b.column_purpose: Number of first-place votes received. Stored as text; empty string for older rows where first-place votes were not recorded (358 rows).

75332f703d4c8828.column_purpose: Season year the salary was paid, 1985-2015.

8df23f9d92498a4d.column_purpose: Three-letter team code of the MLB franchise paying the salary (e.g. KCA = Kansas City Athletics/Royals, NYN = New York Mets, MON = Montreal Expos, SLN = St. Louis Cardinals).

cc74611c3c32edf0.column_purpose: League the team played in: NL = National League, AL = American League.

2acc8a34eaf142fd.column_purpose: Player identifier (playerID format, e.g. bondsba01 = Barry Bonds); references player.col_001. A player can have many salary rows (one per season/team).

feb958097ee444ec.column_purpose: Player's salary for that season, in US dollars (0 to 33,000,000; median 550,000).
